title: The alef letter shown as a large blue alef and a drawn-apart alef
summary: A large blue Hebrew alef (א) with the word alef in blue, above a second, drawn-apart alef made of a big orange diagonal stroke flanked by two small brown yod-like marks. No explanatory text on the slide.

letters.meaning: shown as a diagonal stroke with a mark above and a mark below

pictures.description: The Hebrew letter alef taken apart: a large orange diagonal stroke (the slanted middle of the letter) with one small dark brown yod-like mark at upper right and another at lower left, making up the shape of the letter alef.

uncertain: The slide has no explanation of the orange stroke and two brown marks; reading them as the pieces (yod-vav-yod) of an alef is an interpretation of the image.
